result.title: VoxLution: Evolving Voxels for High-Fidelity 3D Scene Generation
result.summary: High-resolution 3D indoor scene generation is crucial for immersive applications such as virtual reality, spatial computing, and robotics simulation. We introduce VoxLution, a coarse-to-fine transformer-based approach that generates high-fidelity indoor scenes with rich details, overcoming the overly smooth geometry typical of existing generative models. First, we generate a low-resolution spatial layout; then, based on this structural information, we progressively refine the scene geometry locally in chunks. Key to our approach is formulating 3D super-resolution as a sequence modeling problem over multi-resolution sparse voxel grids. To achieve this, we introduce a training-free, resolution-invariant tokenization scheme that compactly encodes the geometric information of eight octants into a single decimal number. We formulate the transformer sequence to include multiple resolutions, allowing the coarse layout to guide the generation of fine local details. To ensure coherence across local chunks, we incorporate adjacent chunk boundary information directly into the transformer sequencing. VoxLution achieves scene generation at a finer voxel resolution than existing baselines, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks with 59.6% lower FPD and 51.1% lower FID on 3D-FRONT, and 70.5% lower FPD and 73.8% lower FID on Scannet++.

AI.brief_summary: VoxLution 用基于 transformer 的由粗到细体素序列建模生成高保真室内 3D 场景：先生成低分辨率空间布局，再分块局部精化几何，并以分辨率无关的八分体编码和邻块边界信息保持整体一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其多分辨率序列化、由粗到细的状态逐步细化与边界一致性约束，可能为 LVR 中分层潜在表示如何先定全局再补局部细节、避免局部块间证据割裂提供类比线索，但原文并不涉及视觉推理或答案使用，需较多核查。
